inputs.text: [excited] It was 2.2 meters long — [quickly] as long as a motorcycle! Standing up, it was 0.9 meters tall — as tall as a 4-year-old! And it weighed 50 kilos — [proud] as heavy as a wolf. [amazed] And scientists think it could run 31 miles an hour — as fast as a car in the city.
[confident] Yes, with long, thin legs, [proud] built for running.
